integrity: Symbolic resultants, critical factorization, discriminant and slope are independently replayable with the embedded script; finite tests do not establish all-parameter claims. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers whole-disk holomorphic Bergman spaces, origin exponent beta>=0, and only integer boundary exponents m=0,...,4. It does not cover punctured-disk spaces permitting poles, fractional m, m>=5 or give global root positions. Uninspected priority literature remains a risk.
title: Sharp first positive radial-power transition of analytic Bergman-kernel zeros
